run_metadata.coverage_summary: The environment's global outbound-egress block is unchanged and was re-verified this run: WebFetch to www.tenders.gov.au/atm failed with DNS ENOTFOUND, and the agent-proxy status endpoint reports enabled=true with an empty recentRelayFailures list - a deliberate network-policy denial, not a transient fault. As a result NO tender detail page or specification document on ANY portal could be opened, so EVERY recorded opportunity is headline-level only (all 26 counted in entries_pending_detail) with no deliverables/requirements/evaluation-criteria/documents/contacts extraction. WebSearch (routed via Anthropic infrastructure, not the egress proxy) was again the only working tool; it is US-indexed and lags the live Australian portals, but extended queries this run surfaced a much richer set of concrete, buyer-originated, future-dated (closing Nov-Dec 2026) opportunities than recent runs, with real tender IDs, across every Tier 1 jurisdiction except the Commonwealth. Captured 26 open opportunities: Victoria/Buying for Victoria (7: Victoria Police eyewear T5956, CFA Cann Valley fire station, Goulburn Valley Water Tatura lagoon remediation [carried, re-confirmed], Gippsland Water GW600 rising main, Latrobe Regional Health payroll RFQ2262, DoTP GPSnet RTK DOT46088 [carried, re-confirmed], Ports Victoria Station Pier fender T421509), NSW/buy.nsw (6: Homes NSW Granville + Grafton, Blacktown City Council cleaning, Wingecarribee lighting, two Local Land Services panels), Queensland/VendorPanel (2 Bundaberg Regional Council: McIlwraith Road upgrade TEN/3109, Airport Sites for Lease TEN/3131), Western Australia/Tenders WA (3: WA Police acoustic-camera/AI WAPOL13726 - now buyer-portal-confirmed after appearing only on an aggregator last run - plus two Public Transport Authority works), Northern Territory/QTOL (5: Darwin seconded-legal panel T26-1314, Alice Springs water-bore drilling T26-1265, Alice Springs Hospital ED ceiling remediation T26-1274, Tennant Creek police complex NTG26-0202, NT Police/Fire marine-equipment panel), ACT/Tenders ACT (2: solar carpark + EV charging EOI PICE0014839, Healthy Waterways research RFT PICE0014602), and South Australia (1 council EOI: Port Lincoln Nautilus Arts Centre tenancy). Tier 3 (mandatory) was checked - SAP Ariba Discovery / SAP Business Network Discovery and the major mining-buyer portals (BHP, Rio Tinto, Fortescue, Woodside) exposed no publicly-visible open Australian RFx (registration-gated or invitation-only); Brisbane City Council's SAP Ariba supplier portal has a tender-publishing & onboarding pause from 5pm 23 Oct to 2 Nov 2026. Corporate portals are retained in discovered_sources and NO corporate opportunities were fabricated. Source discovery: five genuinely new buyer-originated sources recorded - Bundaberg Regional Council (QLD, VendorPanel), Sutherland Shire Council (NSW, VendorPanel), Port Lincoln City Council (SA, email EOI), WA Primary Health Alliance / WAPHA (WA PHN) and Metro Tasmania (TAS GBE).
gaps: EGRESS POLICY BLOCK (global, unchanged): the environment network policy denies all outbound HTTPS to external hosts. WebFetch to www.tenders.gov.au/atm failed with DNS ENOTFOUND; the proxy status endpoint reports enabled=true with zero recent relay failures, confirming a policy denial, not a transient error. Not retried per proxy guidance.

No tender detail page, specification document or portal listing page could be opened on ANY source, so all 26 recorded opportunities are headline-level only - deliverables, requirements, evaluation criteria, documents, contacts and exact value/contract terms could not be extracted from primary sources. Every opportunity is flagged UNVERIFIED-AT-DETAIL pending an authenticated/unblocked detail pass; closing dates and tender IDs come from WebSearch cached snippets of the buyer portals and should be re-confirmed on the live portal when connectivity is restored.

Commonwealth AusTender (tenders.gov.au): no currently-open Commonwealth approach-to-market closing in the target window could be confirmed this run - WebSearch returned only general guidance and older/closed ATMs, and the live portal is unreachable under the egress block. Commonwealth Tier 1 effectively deferred this run.

Tenders SA (tenders.sa.gov.au): the live portal is unreachable and 'Tenders SA' searches collided heavily with South African tender sites; no open South Australian STATE government tender could be surfaced. Only one SA opportunity (Port Lincoln City Council's Nautilus Arts Centre tenancy EOI, a local-government email EOI) was confirmable. SA state Tier 1 deferred.

Tenders Tasmania (tenders.tas.gov.au): only awarded/closed contracts and aggregator pages surfaced; an aggregator-listed City of Launceston 'Blue Cafe and Deck Renewal' item (~13 Nov 2026) could not be confirmed against the buyer portal and was NOT captured. Metro Tasmania and LGAT both reported no open arrangements. TAS state Tier 1 deferred.

GBEs / government-owned corporations (Sydney Water, Melbourne Water, Transgrid, Ausgrid, Australia Post, NBN Co, etc.) were searched but returned only closed, awarded or stale listings via aggregators; no currently-open opportunity could be confirmed against a buyer portal. Deferred to future runs when live-portal access is available.

Universities, TAFEs and CSIRO: searched but returned only closed/stale aggregator listings (e.g. CSIRO 2026-WOR072 energy-flexibility UI, South Metropolitan TAFE LMS maintenance) with no confirmable open closing date. Deferred.

Public health (HealthShare NSW and state Local Health Districts): searched but only aggregator pages with inconsistent dates/status surfaced; no district-level open RFT with a confirmable November 2026 close could be captured against a buyer portal. An NSW Health 'Advance Market Notice 2 - Fixed Wing Non-Emergency Patient Transport' (~2 Nov 2026) is a market notice, not an open RFT, and was not captured. Deferred.

Tier 3 corporate: SAP Ariba Discovery / SAP Business Network Discovery and the major mining-buyer portals (BHP, Rio Tinto, Fortescue, Woodside) exposed no publicly-visible open Australian RFx via search; individual opportunities are registration-gated or invitation-only and were NOT captured as tenders (portals recorded in discovered_sources only). Invitation-only consultancy RFPs remain out of scope and were not fabricated. Retail/bank/telco/energy buyer portals (Woolworths, Coles, CBA, Telstra, AGL et al.) were not re-swept this run beyond the central Ariba + mining check and are deferred.

Prior-run open item NOT re-surfaced this run (egress block; not re-confirmed so not re-listed as a tender to avoid implying fresh confirmation): Country Fire Authority VEMTC Water Management System EOI (closing ~13 Nov 2026, captured 2026-10-18). Treat as potentially still active and re-check when connectivity returns.
recommended_seed_additions: Bundaberg Regional Council (QLD) - publishes tenders on its own news site (brcnow.bundaberg.qld.gov.au) and receives responses via VendorPanel; a reliable regional-Queensland local-government channel that returned two concrete, well-dated open tenders this run.

WA Primary Health Alliance / WAPHA (wapha.org.au/tender) - the Western Australian Primary Health Network; publishes buyer-originated health/community-services tenders. Health-sector source worth monitoring weekly.

Metro Tasmania (metrotas.com.au/corporate/expressions-of-interest-and-tenders) - Tasmanian government-owned bus operator; a GBE procurement channel distinct from Tenders Tasmania (currently no open tenders, but worth monitoring).

Sutherland Shire Council (NSW) and Port Lincoln City Council (SA) - two further buyer-originated local-government channels (VendorPanel and direct email EOI respectively) adding coverage in Sydney's south and regional SA.

Restore live-portal access (lift the outbound-egress block, or run an authenticated/unblocked pass) so that detail pages and specification documents can be opened - without it every run is limited to headline-level, search-cached rows and cannot extract deliverables, requirements or evaluation criteria.

discovered_sources.notes: Regional Queensland local-government channel; a reliable buyer-originated source distinct from the state QTenders portal.

discovered_sources.how_discovered: Surfaced via WebSearch on VendorPanel council tenders; Sutherland Shire Council states it presents RFTs, RFQs and EOIs via VendorPanel and listed an opportunity open 8 Oct closing 27 Nov 2026 (specific title not confirmable under the egress block).
discovered_sources.notes: Southern-Sydney local-government channel on VendorPanel; adds metropolitan NSW council coverage. No specific tender captured this run (title not confirmable).

discovered_sources.how_discovered: Surfaced via WebSearch while querying Tenders WA / WA health procurement; WAPHA (the WA Primary Health Network operator) publishes its own buyer-originated tenders for primary-health and community services.
discovered_sources.notes: PHN health-sector source distinct from state Local Health networks; worth monitoring for commissioning/health-services RFx.

discovered_sources.source_name: Metro Tasmania - Expressions of Interest and Tenders
discovered_sources.how_discovered: Surfaced via WebSearch while querying Tasmanian tenders; Metro Tasmania (the state government-owned bus operator) maintains its own EOI/tenders page - a GBE procurement channel separate from Tenders Tasmania.
discovered_sources.notes: Currently reports no open tenders, but is a buyer-originated GBE channel worth periodic checks (transport/fleet opportunities).

discovered_sources.how_discovered: Surfaced via WebSearch while searching SA tenders (which otherwise collided with South African results); the City of Port Lincoln publishes buyer-originated tenders and email-lodged EOIs on its own council page. Yielded one confirmable open EOI this run.
discovered_sources.notes: Regional SA local-government channel; some opportunities (e.g. the Nautilus Arts Centre tenancy EOI) are lodged directly by email rather than through a platform.

discovered_sources.source_name: SAP Ariba Discovery / SAP Business Network Discovery
discovered_sources.how_discovered: Re-checked this run per the mandatory Tier 3 sweep; the public posting board exposed no publicly-visible open Australian RFx via WebSearch - full opportunity detail requires a free supplier account. Recorded as the portal of record, not as an opportunity.
discovered_sources.notes: Largest single slice of corporate opportunity. access=free-registration; an authenticated session is required to read individual events. No corporate opportunity fabricated. Register a free supplier account to enable an authenticated read in future runs.

discovered_sources.source_name: Brisbane City Council - Supplier Portal (SAP Ariba)
discovered_sources.how_discovered: Re-checked this run; Brisbane City Council runs supplier registration and sourcing on SAP Ariba (self-registration + council approval, ~2 business days). Note a tender-publishing and onboarding pause from 5pm 23 Oct to 2 Nov 2026.
discovered_sources.notes: Known local-government Ariba channel; opportunities are registration-gated. Publishing pause 23 Oct - 2 Nov 2026 means fewer new postings in that window.

discovered_sources.notes: Major mining buyer; access=free-registration via SAP Ariba / interestedsupplier.bhp.com. No opportunity fabricated. Project pipeline (e.g. CD6 / Port Hedland infrastructure) may generate future contractor demand.
